description_en: Modifies the basic information of a database account
description_zh: 修改数据库账户基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-database-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zpr2zyqx603 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-account-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDatabaseAccount

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance where the database account to be modified resides.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the database account to be modified resides.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database account to be modified.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的数据库账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_account_id

parameters.help_en: The new password of the database account
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库账户密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The new name of the database account. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库账户名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: database_account_name

parameters.help_en: The new database schema name. This parameter is required when the database specified by DatabaseId is a PostgreSQL or Oracle database
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的数据库名。当DatabaseId对应的Database为Postgres和Oracle时，DatabaseSchema为必填
parameters.name: database_schema

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
